description: This file defines a servlet class `ImageUrlServlet` that handles HTTP GET and POST requests to serve image URLs based on content IDs, interacting with the OFBiz data model.

classes.name: ImageUrlServlet
classes.description: A servlet class extending HttpServlet that handles requests for image URLs by content ID, supporting both GET and POST methods.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Overrides HttpServlet#doPost to delegate POST requests to the doGet method.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles the HTTP GET requests by parsing the request path, fetching content data from the database, and forwarding the image URL or returning an error.
